title: Discourse Connectors
summary: Link arguments smoothly with contrast, cause, consequence, concession, and reformulation markers.

sections.heading: Contrast and concession
sections.body: Use connectors to control the relationship between ideas. **Mas** is neutral; **porém**, **contudo**, and **no entanto** are more written. **Embora** introduces concession and usually takes the subjunctive.

examples.pt: O projeto é caro, mas necessário.
examples.en: The project is expensive but necessary.

examples.pt: A proposta parece boa; no entanto, exige cautela.
examples.en: The proposal seems good; however, it requires caution.
Although it is difficult, it is possible.

sections.heading: Cause and consequence
sections.body: **Porque**, **pois**, **já que**, and **uma vez que** give reasons. **Portanto**, **por isso**, **assim**, and **desse modo** introduce consequences or conclusions.

examples.en: I didn't go out because it was raining.

examples.pt: Já que você está aqui, vamos conversar.
examples.en: Since you are here, let's talk.

examples.pt: Os custos aumentaram; portanto, o plano mudou.
examples.en: Costs increased; therefore, the plan changed.

sections.heading: Reformulation and organization
sections.body: Advanced speech and writing often use connectors to clarify structure: **ou seja**, **isto é**, **em outras palavras**, **além disso**, **por outro lado**, **em primeiro lugar**.

examples.pt: Ele é autônomo, ou seja, trabalha por conta própria.
examples.en: He is self-employed, that is, he works for himself.

examples.pt: Além disso, precisamos considerar o prazo.
examples.en: In addition, we need to consider the deadline.

examples.pt: Por outro lado, a solução é mais barata.
examples.en: On the other hand, the solution is cheaper.

keyPoints: Portanto is more formal than por isso.
Use punctuation carefully: many formal connectors follow a semicolon or period.

commonMistakes.wrong: Embora é caro, vale a pena.
commonMistakes.right: Embora seja caro, vale a pena.
Porque choveu... / Por causa da chuva...
commonMistakes.note: Avoid nonstandard por causa que in formal language.

commonMistakes.wrong: Mas, no entanto, a ideia funciona.
